title: [3.1.0.2] Still issues with Omnipod Eros pods / reference to #1627
symptom: After importing a JSON file into AAPS version 3.1.0.2, an Eros pod is erroneously shown as active and cannot be deactivated, preventing the start of a new pod. The same JSON file works with version 2.8.2.1 without error.
cause: Due to a change in the way Pod state is handled, upgrading from 2.8 with an active Pod may give problems.
fix: Workarounds: 1) Set the pump driver to the virtual pump, which allowed the profile switch to activate, then switched pump drivers back to Omnipod Eros and retry deactivating. 2) Temporarily switch to developer mode, which offers an additional button to 'force-remove' current Pod registration.
evidence_quote: Due to a change in the way Pod state is handled, upgrading from 2.8 with an active Pod may give problems. To solve your problem: 1. You can try the work around as described in the original issue #1963: Set the pump driver to the virtual pump, which allowed the profile switch to activate, then switched pump drivers back to Omnipod Eros and retry deactivating. 3. Temporarily switch to developer mode. It offers an additional button to "force-remove" current Pod registration.
